import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16.5, 9.2))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1, 1.15], hspace=0.38, wspace=0.26)

# ---------------- Panel A: temporal windows of the three entities ----------------
axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
ent = [
    ("ATP6AP2-CDG (OMIM 301045)\nmissense: G62E, R71H, L98S", 0.0, 3.0, "#b2182b",
     "neonatal jaundice, cholestasis -> cirrhosis, cutis laxa, infections"),
    ("MRXSH (OMIM 300423)\nsplicing: c.321C>T, c.168+6T>A, c.301-11_-10del", 0.3, 60, "#ef8a62",
     "DD/ID from infancy -> epilepsy -> cerebral atrophy -> parkinsonism in adulthood"),
    ("XPDS (OMIM 300911)\nsplicing: c.345C>T", 14, 65, "#4393c3",
     "juvenile spasticity in some; parkinsonism onset juvenile to middle age"),
]
for i, (lab, a, b, c, note) in enumerate(ent):
    y = 2 - i
    axA.add_patch(Rectangle((a, y-0.3), b-a, 0.6, color=c, alpha=0.8))
    axA.text(-1.0, y, lab, ha="right", va="center", fontsize=9)
    axA.text(b+1.0, y, note, ha="left", va="center", fontsize=8.6, color="#333333")
axA.set_xlim(-30, 118); axA.set_ylim(-0.5, 2.8)
axA.set_xticks([0, 1, 5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60])
axA.set_xlabel("age (years), 0 = birth", fontsize=10)
axA.set_yticks([])
for s in ["top", "right", "left"]: axA.spines[s].set_visible(False)
axA.axvline(0, color="#888888", lw=0.8, ls="--")
axA.set_title("A  Temporal windows: allele class sets both the organ and the onset age",
              fontsize=11.5, loc="left")

# ---------------- Panel B: HPO frequency by organ system ----------------
axB = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
# counts of annotated HPO terms per system, per OMIM entity (from ontology.jax.org)
sysdf = pd.DataFrame({
    "MRXSH\n(31 terms)":  {"Nervous system":22, "Head and neck":2, "Growth/onset":4,
                            "Hepatobiliary":0, "Immunology":0, "Genitourinary":0, "Integument":0},
    "XPDS\n(13 terms)":   {"Nervous system":8,  "Head and neck":1, "Growth/onset":4,
                            "Hepatobiliary":0, "Immunology":0, "Genitourinary":0, "Integument":0},
    "CDG2R\n(17 terms)":  {"Nervous system":0,  "Head and neck":2, "Growth/onset":2,
                            "Hepatobiliary":7, "Immunology":3, "Genitourinary":1, "Integument":1},
}).T
sysdf.plot(kind="barh", stacked=True, ax=axB, width=0.68,
           color=["#2166ac", "#92c5de", "#bdbdbd", "#b2182b", "#ef8a62", "#fddbc7", "#f7f7f7"],
           edgecolor="#666666", linewidth=0.4)
axB.set_xlabel("number of annotated HPO terms", fontsize=10)
axB.legend(fontsize=8, ncol=2, frameon=False, loc="lower right")
axB.set_title("B  HPO annotation profiles are almost disjoint\n"
              "(53 distinct terms; 0 disease-specific overlap between CDG2R and the two neurological entities)",
              fontsize=10.5, loc="left")
for s in ["top", "right"]: axB.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# ---------------- Panel C: constraint vs allelic spectrum ----------------
axC = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
cats = ["observed LoF\nin gnomAD v4", "expected LoF\nin gnomAD v4",
        "ClinVar P/LP\nsmall variants", "ClinVar VUS"]
vals = [1, 23.42, 6, 134]
cols = ["#2166ac", "#92c5de", "#b2182b", "#fddbc7"]
bars = axC.bar(cats, vals, color=cols, edgecolor="#555555", linewidth=0.5)
axC.set_yscale("log"); axC.set_ylabel("count (log scale)", fontsize=10)
for b, v in zip(bars, vals):
    axC.text(b.get_x()+b.get_width()/2, v*1.15, f"{v:g}", ha="center", fontsize=9.5)
axC.set_title("C  LoF intolerance (pLI 0.9999, LOEUF 0.203, o/e 0.043)\n"
              "explains a hypomorph-only allelic spectrum and a large VUS backlog",
              fontsize=10.5, loc="left")
axC.tick_params(axis="x", labelsize=8.6)
for s in ["top", "right"]: axC.spines[s].set_visible(False)

plt.show()

print("Depletion of LoF alleles: observed 1 / expected 23.42 = %.3f (90%% CI 0.0152-0.2026)" % (1/23.42))
print("VUS to P/LP ratio among single-gene small variants: %.1f to 1" % (134/6))
